name: simple_bible GUI
spec_note: Widget vocabulary is simple_widgets 0.8.1 (SW_* classes), a deliberate deviation from the eiffel-gui-ux skill's windows platform (simple_vision). D-006: native simple_widgets, no WebView2; gaps are library work items (gap_work_items), never workarounds. Root keys name/version/states/transitions/screens/traceability are read by simple_spec_viz; app/windows/state_machines follow the reference examples in D:/prod/reference_docs/gui/examples. Hebrew and Greek appear in transliteration only in this file.

app.name: simple_bible
app.title: simple_bible
app.description: Free Bible-study workbench: e-Sword simplicity (synchronized panes, one-click lookups) with Logos depth (guides, interlinear, morphology search), engine-owned facts with provenance, CPU-only.

invariants: exactly one active reference per link set
every displayed number has a method record (FR-032)
every displayed fact row has a provenance key (FR-002)
census results always carry all four buckets FITS PARTIAL FAILS NO_DATA (FR-026)
AI-made rows always carry the AI-made label (NFR-014)
no LXX label without its edition
rix.db documents always carry their status chip (D-019)
at most one job of each kind runs; a newer navigation cancels an older one
the GUI processor never runs a query longer than one frame budget; long work is on separate processors

preconditions.go_to: reference parses to exactly one verse_id

postconditions.go_to: active reference of the link set = parsed verse_id; history extended by one
postconditions.switch_mode: data, selection and jobs unchanged; only layout differs
postconditions.census_done: definition frozen; result has four buckets; method stored
postconditions.export_written: attribution present; share-alike notice present when Swete text is included
